title: Refund policy
content: Customers can request a full refund within 30 days of purchase by contacting support with their order number. Refunds are returned to the original payment method and usually take 5 to 10 working days to appear on the statement.

title: Pricing and plans
content: We offer three plans: Starter, Essentials and Pro. Each plan is billed monthly or yearly, and yearly billing includes a discount. You can compare features and upgrade or downgrade at any time from the Settings page.

title: How to reset your password
content: To reset your password, click Forgot password on the login page and enter your registered email. We will send a reset link that stays valid for 24 hours. If the email does not arrive, check your spam folder.

title: Business hours and support
content: Our support team is available Sunday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM Nepal time. Messages sent outside these hours are answered the next working day. Urgent issues can be flagged by adding the word urgent in the subject.

title: Shipping and delivery times
content: Orders inside Kathmandu Valley are delivered within 1 to 2 working days. Orders outside the valley take 3 to 5 working days. You will receive a tracking number by email as soon as your order is dispatched.

title: Canceling your subscription
content: You can cancel your subscription at any time from Settings and then Billing. Your plan stays active until the end of the current billing period, and you will not be charged again after cancellation.

title: Data privacy and security
content: We store all customer data on encrypted servers and never sell personal information to third parties. You may request a copy or deletion of your data at any time by emailing our support team.

title: Installing the chat widget
content: Copy the chat widget script from the Settings page and paste it before the closing body tag of your website. The widget appears within a few minutes. You can change its color and greeting message from the same page.

title: Inviting team members
content: Admins can invite team members from Settings and then Team. Enter their email address and choose a role such as Agent or Team Leader. The invited person receives an email with a link to join your workspace.

title: Supported payment methods
content: We accept major credit and debit cards, eSewa, Khalti and bank transfer. Payments are processed securely, and a receipt is emailed to you immediately after every successful transaction.
